verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official W&B CLI is documented, but it sits under the W&B Models reference path. Nothing in the pack shows the CLI exposing Weave tracing, evaluations, scorers or other Weave functionality, or being designed for AI-native agent workflows. Agent access to Weave is instead evidenced through the MCP server and Skills. missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Weave-specific commands, documented CLI workflows for traces/evals, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
